A release about playlists that leave the app, and words that take over the player.
Built on [MangoTile 1.0.5](https://github.com/Diffechento/MangoTile/releases/tag/v1.0.5).

**The player can show the words instead of the cover.** A button beside the star, the shuffle and
the repeat swaps the artwork in the middle of the player for the song's words. The cover is already
the player's whole backdrop, so nothing is lost. Timed words follow the music: the line being sung is
nearly twice the size of the ones around it, the verse moves up under it as the song goes, and
tapping a line jumps there. A song with no words anywhere keeps its cover, so the setting can stay
on.

**Playlists are `.m3u` files.** Each playlist is a plain file in `Music/Playlists`, the format every
other player and every desktop program reads, naming files rather than database rows, so a rebuild of
Android's media database can no longer scramble them. Playlists you had are converted on the first
launch and the old file is kept. Any `.m3u` on the device can be imported, any playlist exported, and
**songs go in in bulk**: a whole album, artist or genre from its long-press menu, or any number of
songs from a searchable list on the playlist itself.

**Shuffle shuffles the queue.** It used to leave the queue in album order and jump around it, and
could stop the album halfway when its hidden order ran out. Now it rearranges the queue itself, so
what you see is what plays, and turning it off puts the original order back. **"Play next" puts it
next**, every time.

**Long tracks come back where you left them.** Settings → playback → resuming takes a length; a
track at least that long reopens at the exact moment the app was closed. Made for podcasts and
audiobooks; off by default.

**Years in FLAC, Ogg, Opus and ID3v2.4 files are read.** Android's media database ignores the tag
those formats actually use, so a well-tagged FLAC library had no years at all. The app now reads the
year from the file itself where the database left it empty, once per file.

**Getting around.** Tap the artist or the album in the player to open its page; Back brings the
player back up. Tap the next section's header on the start screen to go to that section.

**Fixed: words that could not be fetched offline stayed missing** after the network came back. They
are fetched again as soon as there is a connection, and songs wrongly written off as having no timed
words are asked once more. Timed words from LRCLIB now win over flat words in a file's tags, and an
artist filed under a different spelling there (*DenDerty* / *Den Derty*) is still found.

**Fixed: a black block behind playlist rows**, and a cover square flashing up when the player was
pulled open in the words mode.

---

The APK carries the same signing certificate as every release since 1.0 (`SHA-256 494018a9…2acf7c09`),
so it installs over any of them as an update and keeps your settings, favourites, play counts and
queue.

minSdk 26 · compileSdk 36 · GPLv3 · third-party notices are in the app, on settings → about.
